summary: The SiteProfileHistory module manages records of changes made to site profiles, capturing details like user actions, affected fields, and the user making the changes.
purpose: To track and record changes made to site profiles, providing historical data on user actions and modifications.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the site profile history entry.

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.description: The date when the action was performed.

fields.name: ScreenSection
fields.description: The section of the screen where the action occurred.
